findings.issue: Optional frozen/predictions replay checks compare via JSON.stringify of re-parsed objects, so a legitimately reformatted (key-reordered) review file is rejected even though semantically identical. Fail-closed, usability only.
findings.minimalFix: Compare via a canonicalizing deep-equal (or re-serialize with sorted keys) instead of raw JSON.stringify.

findings.issue: importRisk requires generation equality and never consults reimport_id, so an explicitly revoked-but-still-current review cannot be re-imported at the risk stage (only the action stage honors reimport). Fail-closed; may be intentional but is asymmetric with the documented revocation/reimport policy.
findings.minimalFix: If risk-stage reimport is intended, mirror the importable() reimport_id/generation rule in importRisk; otherwise document risk stage as non-reimportable.

findings.issue: The qualification isCurrent closure compares only reportDigest (dataset+report hash, which excludes assessmentId/generation), so a later re-frozen assessment with byte-identical dataset satisfies currency of an earlier token. Semantically equivalent data, no downgrade or binding escape (binding still checked at read time), but token identity is weaker than record identity.
findings.minimalFix: Also compare assessmentId/digest/generation captured at issuance inside isCurrent.

limitations: Native export/import port implementations (save/open/confirmHumanReview), model reader wiring, shared prediction budget ledger, Settings/startup reconciliation, and profile/source grant readers are separate reviewed scope; their correctness is assumed, not verified here. All reviewed labels and the 200-fact regression are synthetic test data; no real human quality evaluation is claimed or authorized. The prior Kimi P1 (population facts superset persisted) is resolved: freeze filters facts by the deterministic sample before persistence (workflow.ts:46-48), and pre-frozen known severe values remain immutable on risk import (quality-authorization.ts:77-79). No P0/P1 found in the supplied code within scope: digest/generation/context/model revalidation after awaits, savepoint atomicity, exact-ID label matching, severity non-downgrade, statistical gates (>=100, >=30 needs_action, precision>=0.90, recall>=0.95, unknown<=0.10, severe misses 0, unknown-prediction-on-needs_action counted as miss), and deterministic sampling all verify against the actual code and tests.
